card.text: The Owl Nebula is a planetary nebula about 811 parsecs away.

sources.label: Chornay & Walton (2021), A&A 656, A110; CDS J/A+A/656/A110, Table A.1, PN G148.4+57.0: distance 811 pc (782 to 842) from the Gaia EDR3 parallax of its central star

sources.quote: The Owl Nebula is a planetary nebula approximately 2,030 light years away in the constellation Ursa Major.

introduction.text: A Sloan Digital Sky Survey image of it stands here as a flat picture facing the Sun, inside the sphere a paper gives it, 1.70 pc wide.

sources.quote: Estimated to be about 8,000 years old, it is approximately circular in cross-section with a faint internal structure.

sources.locator: Sect. III.1 and Fig. 5: the outer shell is almost circular, 218 arcsec in diameter, and is modelled as spherical
